mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subject) AS subject_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collection) AS collection_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM episode) AS episode_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM import_record) AS import_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE created_at >= CURDATE()) AS today_new_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collection WHERE created_at >= CURDATE()) AS today_new_collections, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operation_log WHERE action = 'LOGIN' AND status = 0 AND created_at >= CURDATE()) AS today_logins
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM user WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE(created_at)
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM user_collection WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE(created_at)
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM operation_log WHERE action = 'LOGIN' AND status = 0 AND created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE(created_at)
SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM user_collection GROUP BY type ORDER BY type
SELECT rate, COUNT(*) AS count FROM user_collection WHERE rate > 0 GROUP BY rate ORDER BY rate
SELECT FLOOR(score) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS count FROM subject WHERE score > 0 GROUP BY FLOOR(score) ORDER BY rate

SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(air_date), '-', CASE WHEN MONTH(air_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'winter' WHEN MONTH(air_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'spring' WHEN MONTH(air_date) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'summer' ELSE 'autumn' END) AS season_key, COUNT(*) AS count FROM subject WHERE air_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY season_key ORDER BY season_key DESC
SELECT import_status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM subject GROUP BY import_status

SELECT COUNT(*) AS import_total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS import_succeeded, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS import_failed FROM import_record

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.name_cn, s.image, COUNT(uc.id) AS collection_count FROM user_collection uc JOIN subject s ON uc.subject_id = s.id GROUP BY uc.subject_id, s.id, s.name, s.name_cn, s.image ORDER BY collection_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
